description:
Caretta Friends is a field app for volunteers who protect loggerhead sea-turtle (Caretta caretta) nests — from the crawl found at dawn to the night the hatchlings reach the sea. Built for Caretta Gazipaşa on Türkiye's protected nesting beaches, and made to work for any sea-turtle volunteer community.

WHAT IT DOES

• Shared map of every nest, beach and trash spot — mark a nest in seconds with an auto-geotagged photo
• AR nest finder — point your phone and see nests pinned where they physically are
• Nest lifecycle — countdown to hatch, a timeline of updates, and an honest temperature-based sex-prediction range
• Excavation record — hatching and emergence success, exported as a PDF for the local authority
• Field guides and facts — what to do when you find a nest, no lights at night, beach rules
• Patrols and coverage — so volunteers don't re-walk a stretch someone already covered
• Your impact — how many hatchlings you helped reach the sea, a streak, badges

Offline-first: capture works with no signal and syncs when you are back online. Works without an account.

Interface in English, Türkçe and Русский.

Open source (MIT): github.com/fortunto2/caretta-friends
Website: carettafriends.com
